description: Apply a set of file writes + deletes as a single atomic commit on a branch (creates the branch if it doesn't exist). The killer agent tool: blob/tree/commit/ref-update sequence. Each change is `{path, content?, content_base64?, deleted?}`. Meets the same branch protection, rulesets and secret scan as a git push, and fires CI/webhooks like one. Requires 'repo' scope.

base_branch.description: Branch to fork from when `branch` doesn't yet exist (default: repo default).

name: gluecron_atomic_multi_file_commit
